I'll think this through as the farmer would, then give the JSON.

---

I farm 6 mu here in Quzhou. Wheat-maize, same as everyone around me. My boys work in town so it's mostly me and the old woman, and I hire a combine at harvest.

**For the wheat** (I plant around early October after the maize comes off):

I buy improved seed from the dealer at the market — the kind most neighbors use, about 15 kg per mu so the stand is thick. Old seed from my own bin doesn't give good ears anymore.

For fertilizer, I do like I've done for years. Two bags of compound (the 15-15-15 kind, 50 kg each) per mu as base before ploughing — that's 100 kg. Then when the wheat greens up in spring after the cold, I spread about half a bag of urea per mu, maybe 25 kg. If it looks yellow I add a bit more at jointing. I'd rather put a little extra than see the wheat go thin — one bad harvest costs more than a bag of fertilizer.

Water: I irrigate before winter (dong shui), then again when it greens up, at jointing, and once at grain filling. Four waterings. The well is there, I use it.

Spray: once for weeds after green-up, once for aphids and powdery mildew around heading. Two sprays.

Tillage: I rotary till after the maize stalks are chopped. That's what the machine man does.

I expect about 450 kg per mu if the spring isn't too dry. Last year I got close to 480.

**For the maize** (I plant right after wheat harvest in June):

Hybrid seed — Zhengdan or whatever the dealer has that the neighbors planted well. About 2 kg per mu, direct seed with no tilling, straight into the wheat stubble. Everybody does it that way now, saves time before the rains.

Fertilizer: one and a half bags of compound (about 75 kg) at sowing with the seeder, then one bag of urea (50 kg) as topdressing at the big-trumpet stage when the plants are waist high. That's around 23 kg N total per mu.

Water: if the summer rain comes I only irrigate once or twice. I'll plan two waterings — one after sowing if it's dry, one at tasseling.

Spray: once for armyworm/borer, once for weeds early on. Two sprays.

No tillage — just direct seed into stubble. That's how it's done here.

I should get 550 kg per mu. Good years I've hit 600.

Total: my fertilizer bill will run about 1,800-2,000 yuan for the year across both crops. Seed maybe 400 yuan. I keep it tight.
